version: Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan (RBSE) Bulletin 2022/2024
board: Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan (RBSE), Ajmer
conflationGuard: REET is a Teacher Eligibility Test. Recruitment for 3rd Grade Teacher posts is conducted separately by RSMSSB (Rajasthan Staff Selection Board).

sections.name: Child Development & Pedagogy (30 Marks)
topics: Concept of Growth and Development, Principles of Development
Theories of Learning (Thorndike, Pavlov, Skinner, Kohler, Piaget, Vygotsky)
Individual Differences, Personality and Intelligence
Understanding Diverse Learners (CWSN, Gifted, Backward, Learning Disabled)
Teaching-Learning Process, Action Research, RTE Act 2009

sections.name: Language I (Hindi / English / Sanskrit / Punjabi / Urdu - 30 Marks)
topics: Unseen Prose Passage, Grammar, Vocabulary
Principles of Language Teaching, Challenges of Language Teaching
Language Skills (LSRW), Teaching-Learning Materials, Remedial Teaching

sections.name: Language II (Selected 2nd Language - 30 Marks)
topics: Unseen Poetry/Prose Passage, Grammar, Literary Terms
Pedagogy of Second Language, Communicative Language Teaching, Evaluation

sections.name: Mathematics (30 Marks)
topics: Numbers up to 1 Crore, Place Value, Basic Operations
Fractions, Prime & Composite Numbers, LCM & HCF
Unitary Method, Average, Profit & Loss, Simple Interest
Plane & Curved Surfaces, Angles, Triangles, Mensuration
Pedagogical Issues of Mathematics, Diagnostic and Remedial Teaching

sections.name: Environmental Studies / EVS (30 Marks)
topics: Family and Relations, Social Evils (Child marriage, Dowry, Child labour)
Clothes, Habitats and Cleanliness
Professions, Public Places and Public Property
Our Culture and Civilization (Fair and festivals, National symbols)
Transport and Communication, Plants and Animals
Pedagogy of EVS, Concept and Scope, Activities, CCE

sections.name: Child Development & Pedagogy (30 Marks)
topics: Development of Child, Learning Process, Diverse Learners, Assessment & Evaluation

sections.name: Language I (30 Marks)
topics: Grammar, Unseen Passages, Pedagogy of Language

sections.name: Language II (30 Marks)
topics: Grammar, Unseen Passages, Pedagogy of Second Language

sections.name: Mathematics & Science (60 Marks) OR Social Studies (60 Marks)
topics: For Math/Science candidates: Algebra, Geometry, Mensuration, Statistics; Physics, Chemistry, Biology; Pedagogy of Math & Science

For SST candidates: Indian Civilization (Indus Valley, Vedic, Mauryan, Gupta), Bhakti & Sufi, Mughal Empire, British Rule; Indian Constitution & Democracy; Geography and Resources of India & Rajasthan; History and Art & Culture of Rajasthan; Pedagogical Issues of Social Science
